description.p: Numi-KDE treats your calculations as a small live document: type expressions like notes and results appear next to each line as you type.

ul.li: Unit conversion and arithmetic powered by libqalculate
Live fiat and crypto exchange rates, mixed-currency arithmetic
Date and time arithmetic, percentages, variables with spaces in their names
Compact always-on-top window toggled by a global shortcut, lives in the system tray

screenshot.caption: Inline help and live results next to each line

description.p: Complex results, scientific notation for very large and very small numbers, consistent half-away-from-zero rounding.
Build-time test coverage for window position memory, the update helper and the calculation engine; no functional changes.
Original application and tray icons restored in all hicolor sizes.

Window position is remembered again on Wayland, updates install silently and restart the app when it is not in use, hardened update helper, single-instance, thread-safety fixes, standard app id and icons.
